Name: SEASONAL SDV OUTFIT NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center]    [b][size=5]SEASONAL OUTFITS IN NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/size][/b][/center]


I adore Nyapu's portraits and wanted all of my mod to match that style. I noticed Nyapu was not planning on doing any of the seasonal portraits... so I decided to do the retextures myself. Unfortunately, the original seasonal mod was a bit complicated to get permissions for. I tried to contact as many of the original artist as I could... but many have left the platform. So I ended up having to redesign and retexture several of the characters myself. However, I did get a lot of help from so many other artists and modders along the way (Please see the permissions and credits). Thank you to everyone who helped support me on this project. It was a long and complicated one. I hope everyone enjoys it. 


[b]IT'S FINALLY DONE!! [/b]


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1.  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url] (CP file)
2.  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
2.  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 
3.  ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits and sprites in the original Seasonal Outfits mod. You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right. If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

NOTE: If you're only doing the portrait replacement, do not DL Nyapu's Vanilla CP file on their page (or disable it if you did), because the mod will not work properly. BUT it's highly suggest you use the CP files instead, because portrait replacements will miss a few NPCs


[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: The quick fixes from before are no longer necessary to get the portraits to work. Nyapu was kind enough to allow us to include their work within ours. So there shouldn't be any more conflicts with their mod and ours. You will still need to DL Nyapu's CP file for portraits that this mod doesn't cover. (Professor, Krobus, Mr.Qi, etc.)[/b]


[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
SVE, RSV, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38930]AHCuteArt Portraits for Maggs Seasonal Sebastian[/url].
Clint Reforged. ( If you have this mod Clint will automatically be disabled. )
Romanceable Rasmodia
Nyapu Sandy for Rose in the Sand by AhCuteArt
AHCuteArt Portraits for Maggs Seasonal Sebastian - Inspired by Nyapu
Piper - a Pierre Rewrite 'n Replace
Any mod that doesn't add or edit SDV Vanilla portraits. 


[i][b]CREDITS:[/b]

GIANT thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url], you are a lifesaver and I wouldn't be able to code without you!
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for creating the seasonal mods in the first place.
Huge thanks to the original artists who worked with me, and for those allowing me to retexture their work:
The full credit list is huge, please see the permissions and credits section for everyone who contributed!!!


[i]If your curious what I am working on next please check out my social media page or my nexus profile. [/i][/i]
